mapper.select: select count(*) from trip_member m join trip t on t.trip_id = m.trip_id join v_trip_period p on p.trip_id = t.trip_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 'JOINED' and t.del_yn = 'N' and p.end_date < trunc(sysdate)

select r.region as region, count(*) as trip_count from trip_member m join trip t on t.trip_id = m.trip_id join v_trip_period p on p.trip_id = t.trip_id join trip_region r on r.trip_id = t.trip_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 'JOINED' and t.del_yn = 'N' and p.end_date < trunc(sysdate) group by r.region order by trip_count desc
select count(*) from trip_member m join trip_like l on l.trip_id = m.trip_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.role = 'OWNER' and m.status = 'JOINED'
